title: Code Cafe — landing and phone mockup

idea.text:
The idea: the café's menu and its printed tickets become the page. Problems are menu items ranked by roast (Easy = Light, Medium = Medium, Hard = Dark), and every submission prints a slip with its verdict.

Light theme = the printed menu. Dark theme = the chalkboard.

Direction dealt by the taste skill: page-is-the-object (seed 665408074), hero redrawn once to 'Striped card beside the room'. App screens (Problems, Workspace, Submissions, Sign in) are in the Figma file.

data.text:
Sample content to confirm before launch: 9 of the 12 problem names and their acceptance rates, the user riya_s, submission numbers, run times and times of day.

The hero Run and Submit are simulated here (Run adds the two numbers you type). In the product they call Judge0.
